intro: Mike, a third-generation painter, does the work himself on every job, inside and out. Locally owned in Lubbock, with free estimates.

highlights.title: Why neighbors call Brush Bros.
highlights.intro: Most of our work comes from folks who have seen a Brush Bros job on their street.

points.name: Owner on every job
points.text: Mike paints it himself, start to finish. No subcontractors.

points.name: You reach Mike
points.text: Call or text and the owner answers.

points.name: Careful prep
points.text: We protect floors and furniture, patch, sand and caulk before the finish coats.

points.name: Walkthrough at the end
points.text: We go through the work with you before we call it finished.

servicesIntro: Homes and businesses across Lubbock and the South Plains. Every project quoted free.

services.name: Interior painting
services.text: Walls, ceilings and trim with clean lines and careful prep, leaving every room ready to live in.

services.name: Exterior painting
services.text: Siding, brick, stucco and trim, washed, scraped, caulked and primed to stand up to West Texas sun and wind.

services.name: Cabinet painting
services.text: Doors and drawers are prepped, primed and sprayed for a durable, like-new kitchen.

services.name: Flake flooring
services.text: Decorative flake coatings for garages, shops and patios that are tough, slip-resistant and easy to clean.

services.name: Commercial painting
services.text: Offices, retail and commercial buildings, inside and out, with lump-sum bids and clear line items.

why.name: Owner does the work
why.text: The big franchises sell the job, then send a subcontractor. Mike paints it himself.

why.name: Three generations of craft
why.text: Over 50 years of combined family experience behind every brush stroke.

why.name: Insured
why.text: Your home and property are protected while we work. Ask us about coverage when you call.

howTitle: A fresh coat in three steps.

steps.name: Request your free quote
steps.text: Fill out the form or call (806) 715-5782. Tell us the rooms, colors and timing.

steps.name: Mike walks it with you
steps.text: The owner looks at the work in person and gives you a straight, written price. No pressure.

steps.name: We paint, owner on site
steps.text: Mike is on the job every day until it's done right, then walks it through with you.
